descriptions.inProgress: Once again, I gave #bPorter#k Rombot's Memory Cards. Fortunately, the deciphering worked this time around, and I was able to get a hold of #b3 Deciphered Memory Cards#k for Kay. Now all I have to do is give them to her.
descriptions.completed: I gave Kay, who's at the Silo of Omega Sector, the #bDeciphered Memory Cards#k that she requested. I'm anxious to see what she makes out of them.
